name: VOCO
description:
VOCO's top-bar companion: a live dictation meter, with Settings, Review, Stop and Quit in its menu. It needs the VOCO app.

On Wayland it holds VOCO's dictation shortcut, so the app you type in never receives it, and it presses VOCO's paste keys: Shift+Insert, only when VOCO asks, never while you hold a modifier, and never at the lock screen. It doesn't read the clipboard.
